instructions.primary_message: Make sure you have enough space in your freezer to accommodate a small baking sheet pan or tray. Arrange 12 (3 oz) paper cups on a baking sheet or tray so that the cups are in a grid pattern and are touching.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ (454 g) pkg strawberries
⅓ medium honeydew melon

instructions.primary_message: Trim and roughly chop strawberries. Place in a blender along with water and maple syrup, then blend on high until smooth. (Add additional water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if necessary, to create a smooth purée.)
Fill cups one-third full with the strawberry purée. (Rinse blender clean and reserve for later use.)

Cover the cups tightly with plastic wrap, then, using a sharp paring knife, make a slit in the wrap in the center of each cup. (Firmly hold the plastic wrap tightly around each cup while you are making the cuts.) Insert popsicle sticks into the purée through the slit. Carefully place baking sheet in the freezer and chill until set, about 1 hour.

When the strawberry purée is set, peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; roughly chop the flesh. Place in the blender along with water and maple syrup, then blend on high until smooth. (Add water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if necessary, to create a smooth purée.)

Remove popsicle cups from the freezer and discard plastic wrap. Carefully fill half of the remaining space of the cups with the mango purée.  Return popsicle cups to the freezer and continue to chill until set, about 1 hour. (Rinse blender clean and reserve for later use.)

When the mango purée is set, trim and peel honeydew; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and roughly chop the flesh. Place in the blender along with maple syrup, then blend on high until smooth. (If a richer green color is desired, add green food coloring to the purée.)
instructions.secondary_message:
pure maple syrup
1 drop green food coloring

instructions.primary_message: Remove popsicle cups from the freezer and carefully fill the remaining space with the honeydew purée. Return popsicles to the freezer and continue to chill until fully set, 2 hours more.
Once set, remove popsicles from the cups (rinse under hot water, from the tap, if necessary, to loosen). Share and enjoy!
